problem:
Let $L=MN.$ What is the value of ${l}_{22}$, if

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}2 & -3 \\ 4 & 2\end{aligned}],\,N=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 \\ -1 & 3 & 3\end{aligned}]?
$$

${l}_{22}=$
{{field-1}}
worked_solution:
Multiplying the $2$nd row in $M$ by the $2$nd column in $N$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{l}_{22} & =[\begin{aligned}2 & -3 \\ 4 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 \\ -1 & 3 & 3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3\end{aligned}] \\  & =4\cdot 2+2\cdot 3 \\  & =8+6 \\  & =14.\end{aligned}
$$
